findings.title: NaN escapes the promised normalized progress interval.
findings.trigger: Call the public normalizeProgress API with Number.NaN (for example, an upstream invalid progress calculation).
findings.observed: normalizeProgress(NaN) calls clamp(NaN, 0, 1), whose Math.min/Math.max result is NaN.
findings.effect: The public normalizer returns a non-finite value outside its documented safe interval. A consumer that relies on this guarantee can receive invalid progress.

findings.suggestedNextAction: Define the domain normalizer's NaN policy, implement it in core without globally changing ordinary clamp semantics, and add a retained regression test under core/test/player. Re-run the probe and core suite/typechecks.
findings.limits: No end-to-end UI/playback failure was established. The introduction date was not investigated, so this is an existing contract defect, not a proven regression introduced by the latest refactor. NaN propagation in the generic clamp is recorded behavior, not independently classified as a defect.
